nodes.name: power_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter steps VIN_12V_24V down to VCC_5V. EN pin enables converter. BOOT-PH bootstrap network required for high-side gate drive. VSENSE feedback sets output voltage. Soft-start via SS pin. This module is the VCC_5V distribution hub for downstream logic and LDO.
Motor power to 5V Buck converter

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VCC_5V down to VCC_3V3 for MCU and peripherals. Low-dropout regulator requires input/output capacitance. This module is the VCC_3V3 distribution hub for all 3.3V logic.
5V to 3.3V LDO

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 Cortex-M3 MCU. Two UART interfaces (one physical UART with addressable drivers) to TMC2209 stepper drivers using PDN_UART pins with different addresses configured via MS1_AD0/MS2_AD1. SPI1 to W25Q64JV Flash for motion parameter storage. GPIOs for STEP/DIR control to both drivers. BOOT0 pulled low for Flash boot mode. NRST needs pull-up. HSE crystal for clock.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: stepper_driver_a
nodes.description: TMC2209 stepper motor driver channel A. UART addressable via MS1_AD0/MS2_AD1 pins (address 0 when both low). PDN_UART provides half-duplex UART interface. STEP/DIR interface for motion control from MCU. VCC_IO powered from 3.3V logic rail. VS_1/VS_2 powered from VIN_12V_24V motor supply. 5VOUT internal regulator output for charge pump. SPREAD pin for spreadCycle/stealthChop selection. ENN active-low enable controlled by MCU. DIAG and INDEX are status outputs to MCU.
Stepper motor driver (channel A)
